result.summary: Security HARD GATE re-review (Step 2c rework 1) for PRM-02..05 promotion pipeline: PASS. All three prior findings confirmed resolved and no new invariant violations. INV-1 BLOCKER resolved: migration 096 is now scope: tenant_only, GBL-143 drops the historical public shadow, promotion_reviews added to BUSINESS_TABLES (lint_migration_schema.py) and the TNT isolation list (21->22); empirically bpm_test has promotion_reviews ONLY in tenant_default (0 in public), events/plat_event_idempotency per-tenant only, tenant storage_mode SCHEMA.
